bias.en: Bearish · retested the $226.5 low, capped by the 100-day
bias.zh: 偏空 · 回测 $226.5 低点，受制于 100 日均线

read.en: Marvell rose 1.4% on Oct 20 to $240.42, rebounding from $226.52 to a high of $243.96. It is above the falling 5-day ($238.4) and rising 200-day ($177.4) averages, but below the rising 100-day ($241.5), falling 10-day ($256.1) and rising 30-day ($253.1). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12 and slipped below zero, its histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 8 ($271.73), and RSI is 44.5.
read.zh: Marvell 10月20日上涨 1.4%，收于 $240.42，自 $226.52 反弹至 $243.96 高点。股价位于下行的 5 日（$238.4）和上行的 200 日均线（$177.4）上方，但低于上行的 100 日（$241.5）、下行的 10 日（$256.1）和上行的 30 日均线（$253.1）。MACD 自 10月12日起位于信号线下方并跌破零轴，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月8日起看空（$271.73），RSI 为 44.5。

read.en: The low retested the $226.5 Oct 16 low and the close reclaimed the 5-day average, but stopped under the 100-day again. Resistance is $241.5 (100-day), then $244–246.6 (Oct 20 and 19 highs) and $253.1 (30-day). Support is $238.4 (5-day), then $226.5 (Oct 16 and 20 lows) and $200.6 (Sep 1 low). A close above $241.5 would open $246.6–253.1; a close below $226.5 would open $200.6.
read.zh: 盘中低点精准回测 $226.5 的 10月16日低点后回升，收盘重回 5 日均线上方，但再度止步于 100 日均线下方。阻力为 $241.5（100 日均线），其次 $244–246.6（10月20日和 19日高点）和 $253.1（30 日均线）。支撑为 $238.4（5 日均线），其次 $226.5（10月16日和 20日低点）和 $200.6（9月1日低点）。若收盘站上 $241.5，可看 $246.6–253.1；若收盘跌破 $226.5，下一目标看 $200.6。
